text: {"lessons":["Most months I did nothing, and that suited my infrequent-checking style; I should make deliberate decisions rather than trade just to feel active.","Selling Stock B and Stock E at gains felt satisfying, but I should not let that satisfaction alone decide when to sell.","Losses feel especially painful and admitting a mistake is hard, so I should judge each holding by its current prospects—not cling to it to avoid realizing a loss or infer future moves from random price history."]}
